name: What are the common signs of storm-damaged drywall that require replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of storm-damaged drywall that require replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of storm-damaged drywall include visible water stains, discoloration, soft or crumbling areas, bulging or bubbling paint, and a musty odor. Even if the damage isn't immediately obvious, water infiltration can compromise the structural integrity of the drywall and lead to mold growth if not addressed promptly. It's crucial to inspect walls, ceilings, and areas around windows and doors after a significant storm for any changes in appearance or texture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water stains, discoloration, soft spots, bulging paint, or a musty smell on your drywall after a storm. These indicate potential damage that may require replacement.
